cards.question: How should a plan show its steps?
cards.why: Recommended: Crew first, because it is the stack you asked for: which delegate is working on which step, and how far each has got, shows before you read a single step.

options.text: 1 One list Every step in order; a step opens in place to its description, and a step that waits says what it waits for. Cost: With several delegates at work it is the longest list, and you read who works on what row by row.

2 Lanes Steps that run at the same time stand side by side in columns, with a line from each step to the steps that wait for it; the line to a working delegate pulses. Cost: Two columns squeeze each step to a few words a line, and on a phone a step opens on a page of its own.

3 Crew first Recommended Who needs you and who is working come first, each with a progress line that pulses while it moves; the to-dos below show who is on each. Cost: A working delegate shows twice, at the top and on its to-do, and you change its step from the to-do, not from the top.
